name: openspec-governance
description: OpenSpec lifecycle governance for Claude Code: stage band, fail-closed edit gate, task progress and an append-only execution log.

gate.title: Edit gate
gate.description: enforce denies Write/Edit outside openspec/ while the active change fails the fail-closed checks; warn only shows a toast; off disables the gate.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: In a project that has openspec/changes, also deny Write/Edit outside openspec/ when no change is active (no plan exists).
